title: Installation Coordination Note: Cancelled Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts and the Special Order Delay Credit
content:
When the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address of a delayed Ridgeline Special Order Services order was cancelled, the delay credit on that order, in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, carries an installation bonus.

**Clause.** The installation bonus depends on the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address: a contract cancelled after the promised ready date of the special order gives an installation bonus of 1.5; a contract cancelled on or before the promised ready date gives 0.5; otherwise the bonus is 0.

The installation bonus is a number of percentage points added to the percentage of the credit base at which the delay credit is figured.

## Records read

The installation contract whose job address is the delivery address of the special order: its status and the date it was cancelled.

## Bonus by contract record (hypothetical promised ready date 13 April)

| Contract at the delivery address | Cancelled on | Installation bonus (points) |
|---|---|---|
| cancelled | 14 April | 1.5 |
| cancelled | 13 April | 0.5 |
| cancelled | 2 March | 0.5 |
| scheduled, in progress or any other status | — | 0 |
| no contract at that address | — | 0 |
